package.description: Find teammates, join lobbies, and talk — the desktop app for the Micr gaming platform.

en-US.description: Find teammates, join lobbies, and talk — the desktop app for the Micr gaming platform.
en-US.longDescription:
Micr is a gaming platform for finding teammates and playing together:
matchmaking lobbies with built-in voice, communities, clans and clan wars,
tournaments, and a desktop overlay with global hotkeys. The desktop app
wraps micrgames.com with game detection, an in-game overlay, and auto-update.
en-US.name: Micr
